summary: Escape from Tarkov entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Escape from Tarkov
entries.definitive_edition: Current 1.0+ PC live client with patch, wipe, edition, account, and server state documented

primary.why: Escape from Tarkov moved from long beta into its 1.0 release on November 15, 2025 and continues to receive live patches. The current PC client is the archive route, but server, wipe, edition, PvE/PvP, account, trader, hideout, quest, flea-market, and anti-cheat state all define the version being played.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Battlestate or Steam PC client. Record patch, launcher/storefront, region/server, wipe status, edition/PvE access, account level, faction, stash/hideout/trader state, questline, selected map, party/solo, raid type, performance, anti-cheat state, and major bugs.

secondary.what_to_play: Document separately if using PvE or Arena rather than the main PvPvE wipe cycle.
secondary.why: They change progression, matchmaking, and preservation value.

secondary.exclusive_content: Old maps, wipes, balance, progression, and edition entitlements
secondary.what_to_play: Document from dated captures/patch notes only unless a preserved build exists.
secondary.why: Current 1.0+ client no longer represents all beta states.

entries.remaster_caveats: Recheck patch and wipe state before every archive run. Keep Arena and old beta states separate.
